description: This file defines a Java interface 'CustomerOptionValueDao' for data access operations related to CustomerOptionValue entities, including methods to list option values by store and language, and to get an option value by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO to manage CustomerOptionValue entities with specific methods for retrieving option values based on store, language, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionValue based on the store and a specific option value code.
